About

I’m studying Mathematics & Computing at BITS Pilani, graduating in 2028. I work on AI applications and the systems around them: model orchestration, retrieval, real-time communication, and backend infrastructure.

Recent projects include voice-based AI interviews, a browser recovery agent, and retrieval-based checks for agent actions. I also ship web and mobile software and lead the 20-member Students’ Union Technical Team.

Outside engineering: competitive programming (1700+ LeetCode contest rating), trekking, and mountaineering. Completed the week-long Kuari Pass trek at 12,350 ft.
